summary: Sets up a voluntary program where the Planning Department can offer zoning incentives to owners of Residential Limited (RL) property who build multi-family rental housing with units income-restricted for 30 years, at no more than 120% of Area Median Income. Owners can't be forced to join, and the Planning Commission decides on applications.

judge.problem: The summary says the program applies to units income-restricted at 'no more than 120% of AMI'. The text sets the limit at the AMI limit established for the applicable zoning district, which may be lower and can never exceed 120% AMI. The summary treats the 120% ceiling as the fixed limit.
